newsitem.title: GERMANY: Decision on German Transrapid train soon - Thyssen.
newsitem.headline: Decision on German Transrapid train soon - Thyssen.

text.p: Thyssen AG, the lead company in the group building Germany's multi-billion-mark Transrapid high-speed train, said on Monday it would decide in the next two months on the project's future.
Chief executive Dieter Vogel told a news conference the consortium would decide in two months at the latest whether the project was still viable after less-favourable income projections.

The high-tech magnetic levitation train, which is planned to run between Hamburg and Berlin from 2005, would now have to work on the basis of lower passenger income than previously anticipated, Vogel said.
